title: Singular genitive: common -si → -de- words
summary: Replace final -si with -de- and add -n in this selected family: käsi (“hand”) → käden.
objectives: Replace final -si with -de- and add -n in this selected family: käsi (“hand”) → käden.

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: The genitive is a case form. It can link a word to an owner or another noun. Here you practise the word form; later lessons show its uses in sentences.
Replace final -si with -de- and add -n in this selected family. The rule does not apply to taksi or bussi.
keyPoints: Learn the word with its stem; the last letter alone does not identify every pattern.

steps: Replace -si with -de-: kä + de + n = käden.
The form changes the grammatical use, while the word keeps its basic meaning.
Replace -si with -de-: ve + de + n = veden.
